text:
Nia L: proposal: create a "slim" quickstart that gets people from signup->deployed in 3 micro-steps: set API key, run a sample SDK request, press deploy. Longform guides live behind a "learn more" link.

Owen R: yes. keep it under 8 lines of code. SDK first, curl tucked into "advanced". also call out that streaming examples are optional and reserved for the advanced page.

Priya V: small UX ask: make the export example platform-agnostic but include bash one-liner: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY="<YOUR_KEY>"`. also add migration blurb for older env name `LEGACY_REDWOOD_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

Nia L: nice. also update code samples to use `responses.create()` instead of `client.generate()`. that was confusing new users in support tickets.

Owen R: i'll refactor the TypeScript and Python snippets. will keep the minimal JS snippet to 6 lines:```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.responses.create({ input: 'say hi' });
console.log(res.output[0].content[0].text);
```

Priya V: i'll add a short troubleshooting block under the auth step: common failures -> bad key / expired key / clock skew. link: https://redwood.example/docs/token-faq

docs-bot: Created PR #4688 - docs/quickstarts/slim-path. Includes SDK-first snippets, env var migration note, and tiny deploy demo app. CI checks queued.

Nia L: can we get a preview build with the deploy demo enabled? product wants to click the button.

preview-bot: Preview ready: https://staging-docs.redwood.example/slim-quickstart-demo (expires in 5 days).

Owen R: reminder: remove any literal API keys like `abc123` from README and use `<YOUR_KEY>`. also include required scopes: generation, embeddings.

Priya V: QA will smoke test tomorrow. can we aim to merge before next sprint planning?

Nia L: yes, target EOD Friday. tagging @Owen R for final review once CI is green. :rocket:
